planets.name: K2-330 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-330 with a 13.8-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: K2-330 b was found in 2021 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-330. Its orbit and size follow de Leon et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
